title: Shivapada Ratnakosha
author: HH Jagadguru Sri Shivarathri Deshikendra Mahaswamiji (Honorary Editor)
description: A descriptive collection of Veerashaiva-Lingayat religious terminologies, using Sanskrit Shaiva Agamas, Kannada literature and Vachanas. Ten-year scholarly expedition under HH Jagadguru Sri Shivaratri Deshikendra Mahaswamiji.

title: Sadhana – Path of Liberation
author: Sri M
description: Speech by Sri M, founder of Satsang Foundation, at 10th Golden Jubilee Endowment. Includes speeches by Dr N.K. Venkataramana and Dr N. Muthu Kumar.

title: Patanjali Yoga Sutras
author: Sri Siddheshwara Swamiji
description: Collection of aphorisms on Yoga in Sanskrit compiled by Sage Patanjali. Commentary by Sri Siddheswara Swamiji of Jnanayogashrama, Vijayapura. Messages from PM Narendra Modi and Swami Ramdev.

title: Narada Bhakti Sutras
author: Sri Siddheshwara Swamiji
description: Compilation of aphorisms on Bhakti by Sage Narada, attributed to 12th century. Helps sadhakas explore the path of devotion.

title: The Heritage of Sri Suttur Math
Shiva Sutras
author: Sri Siddheshwara Swamiji
language: English (Sanskrit original, English translation and commentary)
description: 77 aphorisms on Dhyana (Meditation) by Vasugupta, 10th century Kashmiri scholar. Translated from Sanskrit to English with commentary by Sri Siddheshwara Swamiji. Released by PM Narendra Modi at Sri Suttur Math, Mysuru.

title: Kyathanahalli Sahukar Siddalingaiah
author: Sri G.M. Shivaprasad
description: Biography of Sri Kyathanahalli Sahukar Siddalingaiah, philanthropist and spiritual being, Zamindar from Kyathanahalli village who became disciple of HH Sri Manthra Maharshi Mahaswamiji of Sri Suttur Math.

title: Natyakalavisharada M.C. Mahadevaswamy
author: Prof. M. Nataraja
description: Life of Sri M.C. Mahadevaswamy, doyen of Kannada Dramas, worked for Gubbi Theatrical Company and later established 'Kannada Theatres Private Ltd.' Conferred title 'Natyakalavisharada' by Maharaja of Mysuru.

title: Kayaka Tapasvi Sri Shivaratri Rajendra Mahaswamigalu (Telugu)
author: Dr. H. Thipperudraswamy
description: Collection of 23 lectures delivered at various JSS institutions by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam. First edition: 2008, Enlarged edition: 2021.

title: Bhakthibhandari Basaveshwararin Vachanangal (Tamil)
description: 108 vachanas of Sri Basaveshwara translated into Tamil by Dr. M.V. Jambunathan, Professor of Statistics, University of Mysore. One of earliest attempts to take Basaveshwara's teachings to a neighbouring language (1976). Second edition: 2018.

title: Bhakthibhandari Basavannanavaru (Kannada)
author: M.R. Srinivasamurthy
description: Classic work and one of earliest biographies of Sri Basaveshwara, written by Sri M.R. Srinivasa Murthy. First published in 1931. Under JSS Granthamale first published in 2009; this is the second edition.

title: Neethi Samrajya Shathaka (Kannada)
author: Sri Shivayya Shastri
description: Originally by Sri Shivayya Shastri. Contains 100 verses, edited and revised by Sri S. Nanjundaiah, Retired Professor of Kannada, with commentary. Deals with morals of the people.

title: Swathantra Siddalingeshwararu – Vichara Sankirana (Kannada)
author: Dr. Mruthyunjaya Rumale
description: Research articles from seminar on Swatantra Siddalingeshwara (15th century). Four research papers by eminent scholars, seminar proceedings, photographs. First edition: 2016. Second reprint.

title: Sutturu Srimathada Granthalaya, Mysuru (Kannada)
author: Dr. C.P. Ramashesha
description: Brief introduction about Library of Suttur Sri Math (Mysuru). Narrates wide range and genre of books. Written by Dr. C.P. Ramashesha, Former Librarian, University of Mysore. Includes library science principles.

title: Basava Darshana (English)
author: S.M. Angadi
description: Originally by Sri S.M. Angadi, associated with Shunya Sampadane Project of Karnatak University. Present edition abridged by Dr. D.A. Shankar, Retd. Professor of English, University of Mysore. Poetic narration of Basaveshwara's life and message in free verse. Introduction by Dr. K.R. Srinivasa Iyengar, University of Madras.

title: Globalization: Challenges and the Need for Co-operation
author: Dr. Gita Gopinath
description: Intricacies of fiscal activities in backdrop of world economy. Emphasis on developing Asian nations and challenges faced through tools of co-operation.

title: Space Technology and Societal Applications
author: Dr. A.S. Kirankumar
description: Narrating multifarious activities of ISRO in rebuilding Modern India.

title: Heart To Heart (Enlarged Edition)
author: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam
description: 23 lectures delivered at various JSS institutions by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, teacher-statesman and Karmayogi, aimed at future generations. First edition: 2008, Enlarged edition: 2021.

title: Vrushabendra Vilasa
author: Nanjunda Bhaghvat
description: Milestone in history of editing ancient works. Previously 'Shri Tattvavinishi' was published (shastra); this is poetry - a mahakavya in colour medium.

title: Perspectives in Education
author: All India level writer-educationalists (50 contributors)
description: Fifty articles written and contributed by all India level writer-educationalists.

title: Naming the Nameless
author: Rowena Hill & Prabhu Shankara
description: Translation of 101 Kannada Vachanas of 12th century mystics and saints of Karnataka. Representative selection from major and minor writers. Exceptional relevance of women writers' attitudes.

title: Forever Saints
author: D A Shankar
description: Finest and most representative vachanas of three major Veerashaiva saints of 12th century: Basavanna, Allama Prabhu, and Akka Mahadevi in a single volume.

title: Heart to Heart
author: Dr. A P J Abdul Kalam
description: Ten thought-provoking lectures delivered by former President Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam on various occasions in JSS Institutions.

title: Nijaguna's Exposition of Spiritual Wisdom
author: Sri Siddeswara Swamiji
description: Free rendering in English of last section of Kaivalya Paddhati (jnana-pratipada-danasthala). Translator Sri Siddheswara Swamiji of Jnanayogasrama, Bijapur, faithful to spirit of original Kannada text.

title: Prasada
author: JSS Mahavidyapeetha
description: Scientific classification and indexing of article headings published in JSS Mahavidyapeetha 'Prasada' periodical. Sourcebook for researchers and literature enthusiasts. Xerox copies available on request.

title: Prasada Sampada
author: JSS Mahavidyapeetha
description: Selection of 74 articles published in JSS Mahavidyapeetha's bi-monthly literary periodical 'Prasada' over past 42 years, compiled for readers' use.

title: Swara Vachana Samputa
author: Sri Jagadguru Shivrathrewara Ghranthmale
description: Tattvikke tattva, sahityakke sahitya - Vachana literature promoting self-welfare and social welfare. Aimed at making original literature available to public.

title: Veerashiva Dharma Darshana
author: Sri Jagadguru Shivrathrewara Ghranthmale
description: Two-volume work on Veerashaiva Dharma Darshana. For those who studied 'Vishwa Dharma Darshana', this provides essential understanding. Veerashaiva Dharma has no geographical or linguistic limits. Selected best articles organized here.

title: Vishwa Dharma Darshana
author: Prabhushankar
description: Essence articles opening readers' eyes to all religions and thoughts of the world, compiled in 'Vishwa Dharma Darshana' volumes.

title: Yella Puratana Vachanagalu
author: Madhu Venkareddy
edition: Three volumes published by JSS Granthamale
description: Research and publication of Vachana literature for a century. Discovering unpublished vachanas, publishing them, correcting errors in already published ones. Three volumes of 'Yella Puratana Vachanagalu' published by JSS Granthamale.

title: Veerashiva Darshana
author: Dr. B V Mallapur
description: Part of 'Sharana Samskruti Male' series introducing Sharana literature, life philosophy, religious and cultural traditions to students and general public. 100 books planned; 69 published so far.

title: Shatasthalagalu
author: Annadhaniswara Mahaswamigalu
description: Part of 'Sharana Samskruti Male' series. Introduces Sharana literature, life philosophy, religious and cultural traditions to students and general public.

title: Panchachara
author: H Gangadharan
description: Part of 'Sharana Samskruti Male' series. Covers five basic principles (Panchachara) of Veerashaiva faith.

title: Asthavarana
author: Dr. Mallikarjun S L
description: Part of 'Sharana Samskruti Male' series. Covers eight coverings (Ashtavarana) in Veerashaiva tradition.

title: Shaivagamagalu
author: Dr. M Shivakumar Swamigalu
description: Part of 'Sharana Samskruti Male' series. Covers Shaiva Agamas in Veerashaiva tradition.

title: Kayaka Mattu Sharanaru
author: Dr. Basavaraj Malashetty
description: Part of 'Sharana Samskruti Male' series. Covers Kayaka (labor) and Sharana traditions.

title: Allama Prabhu Devara Vachana
author: Sri Siddheswara Swamigalu
description: Commentary on Allama Prabhu's vachanas. JSS Granthamale has published selected vachana commentaries of Basavanna, Allama Prabhu, Channabasavanna, Ganalinga Deva, and Akkamahadevi in this series.

title: Molige Mahadevi Vachanagalu
author: Dr. Basavaraj Malashetty
description: Commentary on Molige Mahadevi's vachanagalu. Part of Vachana Vyakyana Male series publishing selected vachana commentaries.

title: Sharanara Vachanagalu
author: Not specified on page
description: Vachana commentary in Vachana Vyakyana Male series.

title: Sharanara Vachanagalu – Edition 4
author: Dr. Jayashree
description: Vachana commentary by Dr. Jayashree. Edition 4 of the series.

title: Sharanara Vachanagalu – Edition 10
author: Dr. Jayashree
description: Vachana commentary by Dr. Jayashree. Edition 10 of the series.

title: Sharanara Vachanagalu – Edition 11
author: Dr. Jayashree
description: Vachana commentary by Dr. Jayashree. Edition 11 of the series.

title: Dharmaratnakara K Nandibasappa
author: Prof. H T Shailaja
description: Part of 'Virashaiva Punya Purusharu Male' series profiling prominent Virashaiva personalities from Chamarajanagar and Mysore districts. Lives serve as inspiration for future generations.

title: Dr. M J Najundaradya
author: Prof. H T Shailaja
description: Part of 'Virashaiva Punya Purusharu Male' series profiling prominent Virashaiva personalities from Chamarajanagar and Mysore districts.

title: M N Mahanthadevaru
author: Prof. H T Shailaja
description: Part of 'Virashaiva Punya Purusharu Male' series profiling prominent Virashaiva personalities from Chamarajanagar and Mysore districts.

description: Part of 'Virashaiva Punya Purusharu Male' series profiling prominent Virashaiva personalities from Chamarajanagar and Mysore districts.

title: S N Mariyappa
author: Prof. K Ramamurty Rao
description: Part of 'Virashaiva Punya Purusharu Male' series profiling prominent Virashaiva personalities from Chamarajanagar and Mysore districts.

title: M N Basavarajayya
author: Prof. H T Shailaja
description: Part of 'Virashaiva Punya Purusharu Male' series profiling prominent Virashaiva personalities from Chamarajanagar and Mysore districts.

title: Sirumana charithe
author: Not specified on page (Kenchishettyya Suta Raman's Sirumana Charite)
description: Story of Sirumana, a Palegara (feudal lord) named Sirumana. Contains war episode of Sirumana's life. Published in 1991.
